name: Opiner Me
author: eeqsoft

sections.description:
Opiner Me is a lightweight, modular plugin for collecting user opinions with star ratings. Built for developers who value clean architecture and users who appreciate intuitive UX. Includes built-in support for SEO-friendly JSON-LD schema markup for reviews and ratings.

Features:
* Opinion form with rating stars
* Shortcode integration for easy placement
* SpamGuard module for basic filtering
* Modular architecture (Validator, Sanitizer, Renderer, etc.)
* Admin panel with shortcode preview and opinion list
* Logger and LogViewer for debugging and diagnostics
* Generates SEO-friendly structured data (JSON-LD) for ratings and reviews

Built with PHP 8.0+, using modern patterns and clear separation of concerns.

Compatibility

This plugin has been tested with PHP 8.0 and WordPress 6.0+.

Please note: when running WordPress 6.0 on PHP 8.1 or newer, you may encounter
deprecated notices originating from WordPress core (e.g. preg_replace() usage in
wp-includes/kses.php). These notices are not caused by this plugin and do not
affect its functionality. The issue has been resolved in later WordPress
versions (6.3+). On PHP 8.0, as declared, the plugin runs without such warnings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Use [opiner_me_form] to display the form
  4. Use [opiner_me_list] to display submitted opinions
sections.faq:
Can I customize the form?

Yes, the plugin uses clean CSS and modular PHP classes. You can override styles or extend logic via hooks.

Does it block spam?

Basic spam filtering is included via the SpamGuard module. You can extend it or integrate with external tools.
